prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production texture background for Wayfinder, an illustrated World of Warcraft Classic quest atlas. Create an original exceptionally polished front-facing fantasy interface frame, landscape 3:2 composition, 1536x1024 or larger. Restrained engraved antique gold and burnished bronze corners and fine gold rules over almost-black blue-charcoal leather. Exact layout: outer border inset 2.5%; full-width dark masthead from 5% to 13% height; full-width dark navigation strip from 14% to 20%; main content from 22% to 92% height. Main content has left navigation panel from x5% to26%, middle reading panel x28% to72%, and right record panel x74% to95%. All three panels DARK charcoal blue leather, subtle material, not parchment. Thin crisp metallic borders, elegantly layered bevels, engraved compass motif on outer top center, tiny restraint in ornament. Full frame entirely visible in flat orthographic view. Each content region perfectly empty and quiet for live game text. High-end handmade fantasy game UI asset, minute authentic surface detail, no perspective distortion. No text, lettering, numerals, logos, progress bars, scenery, icons, UI mockups, fake buttons or watermarks. Decoration confined to outer border and fine dividers.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production environmental art sprite sheet for the Wayfinder fantasy quest atlas. Make an EXACT regular 4-column by 5-row grid of 20 separate landscape paintings, equal cell sizes, no gaps, no borders, no labels, no text. Overall image 8:5 landscape aspect, ideally 2560x1600 or larger; each panel 2:1 landscape. Every panel a crisp, richly detailed, professionally painted classic fantasy game environment with dramatic readable silhouettes, nuanced warm/cool lighting, no characters, no closeup UI. Keep landmarks in central horizontal band so crops work. Consistent painterly realism inspired by Warcraft environments. Panels in EXACT row-major order: row1: [1 gigantic purple enchanted tree forest and elven wooden bridge at twilight (Teldrassil); 2 red canyon spires and spiked orc settlement at golden sunset (Durotar); 3 green prairie mesas and tribal tents at dawn (Mulgore); 4 antique parchment compass rose, decorative cartography without literal terrain]. row2: [5 vast dry golden savanna with flat-topped acacias (Barrens); 6 gloomy sea coastline with giant dark evergreens and ruined elven stones (Darkshore); 7 tall rocky pinnacles and rugged pine valleys (Stonetalon); 8 lush purple-blue enchanted forest with silver stream (Ashenvale)]. row3: [9 dry canyon of impossibly tall sandstone needles with rope bridges (Thousand Needles); 10 bleached grey barren plain with twisted dead trees and distant purple mountains (Desolace); 11 foggy green swamp with cypress trees and small wooden fort (Dustwallow); 12 deep emerald rainforest and immense ancient trees with mossy ruin (Feralas)]. row4: [13 golden sand dunes and desert sandstone town (Tanaris); 14 autumn gold coastal ruins with turquoise ocean (Azshara); 15 dark corrupted forest with subtle sickly green glow (Felwood); 16 primeval lush jungle crater with smoking volcano (UnGoro)]. row5: [17 snowy blue mountains and purple fir forest at sunset (Winterspring); 18 windswept ochre desert with insectlike obsidian ruins (Silithus); 19 antique parchment and nautical compass vignette; 20 ancient travel journal on dark leather]. No words, lettering, icons, people, hero characters, recognizable logos, grid labels, or watermarks. Exactly 20 separated scenes in perfectly equal cells.
